integrity: The primary 2026 source was checked through its space definition, coefficient-moment asymptotic, endpoint boundedness theorem, and subcritical counterexample. The compact phase is proved by an exact diagonal compact embedding, while endpoint noncompactness is proved with an explicit bounded weakly null polynomial block sequence and a uniform lower bound on its Hilbert images. The 2018 logarithmic Bergman source and broader generalized-Hilbert compactness literature were compared for implication coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies boundedness versus compactness for the Hilbert matrix from the logarithmically weighted Hilbert scale A_log^alpha^2 into A^2. It does not determine the exact endpoint essential norm, does not treat p different from 2, and does not extend to arbitrary generalized Hilbert measures.
title: Compactness phase transition for the logarithmic Hilbert matrix endpoint
